impact.name: Expected impact
impact.description: Expected contribution to the stated goal and affected groups.
limitations: Expected impact is not observed impact.
Distributional effects should be recorded separately.

evidence_confidence.name: Evidence confidence
evidence_confidence.description: Strength and relevance of evidence supporting the option and its assumptions.
limitations: High confidence does not guarantee a desirable outcome.

feasibility.name: Feasibility
feasibility.description: Practical ability to deliver the option with available capabilities, time, and dependencies.
limitations: Current feasibility can change as resources and constraints change.

urgency.name: Urgency
urgency.description: Time sensitivity, consequence of delay, and relevance of the decision deadline.
limitations: Urgency should not automatically override importance or safety.

strategic_alignment.name: Strategic alignment
strategic_alignment.description: Fit with the declared goal, scope, institutional commitments, and decision context.
limitations: Alignment can reinforce a flawed strategy and should remain reviewable.

equity_and_harm.name: Equity and harm review
equity_and_harm.description: Distribution of benefits, burdens, exclusion risks, foreseeable harms, and mitigation readiness.
equity_and_harm.gate_requirement: No unresolved severe harm or exclusion risk may be hidden by an aggregate score.
limitations: A numeric value cannot replace affected-group review or formal safeguards.

resource_efficiency.name: Resource efficiency
resource_efficiency.description: Expected value relative to financial, staffing, time, and operational requirements.
limitations: Efficiency should not erase absolute resource constraints or externalized costs.

reversibility.name: Reversibility
reversibility.description: Ability to stop, revise, or recover from the decision without disproportionate cost or harm.
limitations: Some effects may remain irreversible even when implementation is technically reversible.
